title: Question on the page "rangeSlider"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[rangeSlider](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/rangeSlider.html)".

I have an issue with the rangeSlider widget where it only works on the price field.
I have included the taxonomy for my field ABV to my indices and I can see the choices as checkbox option on the site but when I try to use the rangeSlider widget similar to price field, it won’t return any hits from the API
